title: Footings for temporary barriers or shields in areas of special flood hazard or shaded X-Zones.
officialText: In areas of special flood hazard or shaded X-Zones, continuous footings for the support and attachment of temporary, removable dry floodproofing barriers or shields may be constructed to project beyond the street line not more than 12 inches (305 mm) both at grade and below grade.
